title: cal why --json
description: The commits that last changed a file or line (git blame), newest first, each with the sessions inferred to have produced it and their decisions and gotchas.

schema_version.description: Major version of this payload's shape. A reader refuses a version newer than it knows.

file.description: The file, relative to the repo root, with `/` separators.

line.description: The 1-based line asked about; null for the whole file.

repo.description: The repo root (git's toplevel) the file was blamed in.

commits.description: The commits that last changed the line, or the file's lines, newest first.

unlinked.description: True when no commit here links to a session yet: run `cal commits` in the repo.

uncommitted.description: True when the line (or some of the file) has changes no commit owns yet.

lines.description: Lines of the file this commit last changed (1 for a single line).

ranges.description:
Those lines as inclusive `[start, end]` runs of 1-based line numbers in the blamed
file (the saved file, or the editor buffer with `--stdin`), ascending, so an editor can
mark them without a blame of its own. Optional in the schema only because a `cal` from
before it does not print it; it is never empty.

threads.description:
The sessions inferred to have produced the commit, best first: the ones that edited
this file, then read it, then mentioned it.

trace.description:
Attributions from Agent Trace records the repo carries (`.agent-trace/*.jsonl`), read
at query time: what another tool recorded about this commit's lines, even for a
conversation the index has no transcript of. Omitted when there is none.

lastActive.description: When the thread last changed, epoch seconds.

edits.description: Edit and write tool calls on this file inside the thread.

touch.description:
The strongest thing the thread did to this file: `write`, `edit`, `read` or
`mention`; null when only the commit's other files linked it.

overlap.description: Files the thread and the commit share (the link's confidence, not normalized).

facts.description: The thread's decisions and gotchas, pinned first.

extractor.description: Who wrote it: llm, heuristic, user, agent, or an importer such as claude-memory.

from.description:
Always `agent-trace`: read from a trace record in the repository, not inferred from
a transcript in the index.

agent.description: The agent the record names (`metadata.agent`, else `tool.name`), e.g. `cursor`.

model.description: The model, `provider/model` per models.dev, when the record names one.

conversationId.description:
The conversation id the record carries (`metadata.conversation_id`, else
`metadata.session_id`).

conversationUrl.description: The record's link to the conversation, often a local `file://` transcript path.

threadId.description: The indexed session with that conversation id, when there is one.

ranges.description:
The lines the record attributes in this file, inclusive `[start, end]` runs at the
recorded revision (not today's line numbers); empty when the record names the file
without ranges.

recordedBeforeCommit.description:
The revision is the blamed commit's parent: the record was written while the change
was being made (the reference hook's habit), before it was committed.

recordedAt.description: The newest `timestamp` among the merged records (RFC 3339).

traceFile.description: The file the record came from, relative to the repository root.

TraceAttribution.description: One conversation a trace record attributes lines of a blamed commit to.
